matches.description: Watch Feyenoord vs GO Ahead Eagles highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 16, 2026. A captivating Eredivisie clash on August 16, 2026 , saw Feyenoord and GO Ahead Eagles locked in a fierce battle that ultimately ended all square. While Feyenoord held an advantage for much of the game, a late surge from GO Ahead Eagles snatched a dramatic equalizer, leaving both sides to ponder what might have been. Early Dominance and Feyenoord's Lead Feyenoord took the lead in the 32nd minute when Gjivai Zechiel found the back of the net, with Ayase Ueda providing the assist. Their advantage was then doubled in the 38th minute, as Ayase Ueda himself headed home after a telling contribution from Anis Hadj Moussa . The home side looked in control, but the second half was set to bring a significant shift in momentum. Tengstedt Ignites Eagles' Comeback The resilience of GO Ahead Eagles shone through in the 63rd minute. Soeren Tengstedt pulled one back for the visitors, a goal set up by Evert Linthorst . This goal offered a glimmer of hope and spurred the Eagles on as the match entered its decisive phase. Late Drama and Sigurdarson's Heroics The true drama unfolded in the final ten minutes. In the 80th minute, substitute Stefan Ingi Sigurdarson delivered a crucial blow, heading home to bring GO Ahead Eagles level. The goal was subjected to a lengthy VAR review, but the referee ultimately pointed to the center circle, much to the delight of the traveling fans. The dying moments of the game were frantic; Mika Marmol and Mathis Suray both rattled the crossbar with powerful efforts, while Ayase Ueda saw his late header thwarted. Despite Feyenoord's late pressure, the Eagles held firm. Match Conclusion The final whistle blew with the scores level. Feyenoord enjoyed a slight edge in possession, with 53% of the ball, but GO Ahead Eagles proved their mettle, securing a hard-fought point. The attendance for this exciting encounter was 47,500.
